title: Agent T gives you the lead

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Today is your lucky day.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Your use of a formal honorific suggests that you are flirting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your use of a formal honorific suggests that you are flirting.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You have been selected for greatness. For an interview with Ms Mary-Nyx Curzona herself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have been selected for greatness. For an interview with Ms Mary-Nyx Curzona herself.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Do not make me change my mind by displaying your ignorance. Ms Curzona is currently CEO of Curzona's Fifth Division.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do not make me change my mind by displaying your ignorance. Ms Curzona is currently CEO of Curzona's Fifth Division.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Business. Yes. You have been selected for greatness. For an interview with Ms Mary-Nyx Curzona herself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Business. Yes. You have been selected for greatness. For an interview with Ms Mary-Nyx Curzona herself.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Flirting is against CorpSec policy.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: We mustn't...

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Oh, I could fine you for a lot of things... but down to business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I could fine you for a lot of things... but down to business.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: She recently acquired the Serpentarium Club in the Spire, and is looking to recruit a co-owner. I don't need to tell you it is the most exclusive venue in the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She recently acquired the Serpentarium Club in the Spire, and is looking to recruit a co-owner. I don't need to tell you it is the most exclusive venue in the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I passed on a recommendation. She wishes to interview you for the role.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I passed on a recommendation. She wishes to interview you for the role.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I did. I consider you... somewhat above average.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did. I consider you... somewhat above average.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I'll make the appointment and send the details. Do not let me down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll make the appointment and send the details. Do not let me down.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: A mistake. Perhaps I misjudged my... opinion of you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A mistake. Perhaps I misjudged my... opinion of you.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: One of the most powerful people in the LUZ and all of Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One of the most powerful people in the LUZ and all of Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It is now that you're here, Mr Agent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is now that you're here, Mr Agent.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It is now that you're here, Mr Agent.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It is now that you're here, Mr Agent.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How come?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does she want with me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does she want with me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What does she want with me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What does she want with me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm glad you noticed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Down to business...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I won't tell if you don't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I won't tell if you don't.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I won't tell if you don't.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I won't tell if you don't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you come over later and fine me for it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you come over later and fine me for it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why don't you come over later and fine me for it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why don't you come over later and fine me for it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd be the perfect choice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She wants to recruit me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, but no thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll be there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You recommended me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The feeling's mutual.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never heard of her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: To what do I owe this honor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To what do I owe this honor?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: To what do I owe this honor?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: To what do I owe this honor?
